topics.title: Meaning of human settlements and rural-urban differences

concepts.learning_objective: Define a human settlement and explain how settling involves grouping people and apportioning territory.
Distinguish rural and urban settlements by economic base, functional links and social relations.
Identify the physical, cultural-ethnic and security factors that shape rural settlement types in India.
Describe clustered and semi-clustered settlements and the regions where they occur.
Describe hamleted and dispersed settlements, their causes and their regions.

topics.title: Urban settlements and evolution of towns in India

concepts.learning_objective: State the Census of India 1991 criteria for classifying a place as urban.
Classify Indian towns as ancient, medieval or modern and give examples of each.
Explain how the level of urbanisation is measured and state India's level in 2011.
Interpret the trends of urbanisation in India from 1901 to 2011 using Table 2.1.
Classify Indian towns by their dominant function with suitable examples.
Explain why growing cities become multifunctional and resist a single functional class.
State the objective and key features of the Smart Cities Mission.
